rows.definition: The typed residency event in internal/engine/cacheevents.go: CacheEvent carries created/stored/removed/updated residency changes with tier and priority diffs as the engine normalizes live-engine events into the shared cachemeta.Entry stream; CacheEventRoutingReceipt and CacheEventMetrics render the aggregate Prometheus view keyed by (direction, outcome, to_tier).
rows.distinction: The event RECORD/stream file, not the recorder type that persists it (x2-cache-cacheeventrecorder), not the sink a caller installs (x-cache-setcacheeventsink), and not the emit call site (x-cache-emitcache).

rows.definition: The internal/h2hbench function behind `fak bench h2h plan`: for each --arm in the order given it emits the exact single-arm `fak bench h2h run` invocation with its own ledger under --ledger-dir, printing the commands without executing them (verb-surface SOURCE ONLY dispatch arm of runBenchH2H).
rows.distinction: A dry-run INVOCATION PRINTER for the h2h benchmark, not the executed benchmark (runBenchH2H and its run/report/gpu-idle sibling arms) and not a ctxplan planning cell or budget plan.

rows.definition: Engine.ForwardSlot() in internal/modelengine (Continual Engine phase 0): returns the engine's forward-pass slot, the whole-old/whole-new install/revert unit pinned while a forward pass runs, witnessed by forward_slot_test.go's install/revert round-trip.
rows.distinction: A forward-pass SLOT handle inside the model engine, not a session worker index (SessionSlot / x-session-runtime-sessionslotfield) and not a KV cache slot or dispatch lease seat.

rows.definition: The successor-plan local in cmd/ctxplandemo's demo loop: nextPlan = ctxplan.PlanCells(allSpans, learned, ctxplan.Budget{Tokens: budget}, tokCost) is recomputed each iteration and admitted only when ctxplan.Audit(nextPlan).Faithful holds and the budget is not exceeded.
rows.distinction: A demo-loop LOCAL holding the recomputed plan value, not the PlanCells planner itself, not a persisted plan policy, and not the h2h benchmark plan verb (runBenchH2HPlan).
